I will put a little fertilizer on this plot — about half of what my neighbor uses on his bigger field — because I shared a bag with him and I know the maize needs it to grow tall. I will also spread manure from my goats since I own this land and it keeps the soil good, but I will plant the seed I saved from last year because those new seeds cost too much money. Me and my family can do all the hoeing and weeding ourselves on this small plot, so I will not hire anyone, and I will not buy chemicals or water pipes when the rains are coming soon.
